goal: Prevent external hardware signers or bridge tools from altering outputs or amounts in outgoing transactions
Stop signers from using unsafe sighash flags that allow third parties to mutate transactions post-signing
Enable tests to simulate compromised signers returning tampered signatures across various descriptor types
reviewability: Waiting on reviewer re-review following a trivial rebase
agreement: Strong consensus on hardening external signer processing and improving mock tests
Verified external signer rejects unsafe sighashes, finalized inputs, and corrupted signatures (fametrano)
Verified mock signer mutations are caught and reviewed external signer code (vicjuma)
Resolved concern that finalized PSBT responses could conceal unsafe sighashes (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it prevents fund theft and post-signing transaction mutation by buggy or compromised signers
Protects all wallet users relying on hardware devices or bridge utilities from trusting them blindly
